name: TableMaster for Elementor – Advanced Responsive Tables for Elementor
author: BloomPixel

sections.description:
TableMaster for Elementor allows you to design, edit, and manage responsive, data-rich tables directly inside the Elementor editor – with zero coding skills required.

If you’re a blogger, agency, business owner, or web designer, TableMaster helps you display data in stunning, mobile-friendly tables in just a few clicks.

Seamlessly Integrated With Elementor

TableMaster brings advanced table addons for Elementor, helping you build stylish and functional tables without coding.

You can drag the Elementor table widget into your layout, start adding content, apply styles, and instantly see the results with live editing.

You don’t need to switch screens or refresh the page to preview changes.

Everything happens visually inside Elementor’s native environment.

This lets you:

  • Save time on repetitive tasks
  • Avoid manual HTML table formatting
  • Keep your table design aligned with the rest of your Elementor pages
  • Avoid the hassle to style for multiple devices as this Elementor responsive table adapts seamlessly to all screen sizes and resolutions

Why Choose TableMaster for Elementor?

TableMaster brings the simplicity of Excel and the flexibility of Elementor together in one powerful, easy-to-use plugin.

With real-time visual editing, dynamic data support, and advanced styling controls, TableMaster gives you complete control over how your data is displayed, with no workarounds or external tools needed. In short, it is perfect Elementor table builder for every kind of user.

This plugin is perfect for marketers, eCommerce stores, educators, and anyone who needs to present structured data in an organized, professional format.

Love Elementor? With Table Master, you get a fast and responsive table widget for Elementor — better than Ninja Tables, TablePress, WP Table Builder, or wpDataTables.

FREE Features – Everything You Need to Get Started

The free (lite) version of TableMaster gives you powerful tools to build beautiful and responsive tables with ease.

Core Table Features:

  • Built specifically for Elementor
  • Stack or Scroll – Two responsive table modes
  • Visual drag-and-drop table builder
  • Manual data entry with intuitive editor
  • Import data from CSV files
  • Import data from TablePress

Styling & Design Controls:

  • Style table structure with width, spacing, and alignment options
  • Customize headers with full control over font, background, borders, alignment, and padding
  • Apply row styles like alternating backgrounds, text color, and spacing
  • Customize individual cells with typography, text, and background color, border styles, and alignments
  • Enable column span and row span for more flexible layouts

PRO Features – Create Dynamic Tables With Advanced Controls

When you’re ready to take your tables to the next level, TableMaster Pro offers advanced features for dynamic data handling and a better user experience.

📥 Data Source Integration

  • CSV Import: Import data from CSV file URLs in a few clicks
  • Google Sheets Integration: Connect live data from Google Sheets and keep tables updated automatically
  • Dynamic WordPress Data: Pull dynamic data from WordPress posts, pages, custom post types, taxonomies, and users

🔎 Enhanced Table Functionality

  • Sortable Columns: Enable column sorting so visitors can sort by name, price, or date
  • Search Box: Add real-time search filtering to help users find what they need faster
  • Pagination: Break large tables into pages using pagination for better readability
  • Table Info Display: Show helpful table statistics like total entries and visible rows
  • Tooltips Support: Add tooltips to provide extra information without cluttering the table

Use Cases – What Can You Create with TableMaster for Elementor?

TableMaster is incredibly versatile and works great for almost any website.

Here are just a few examples of what you can build:

  • Comparison tables for affiliate blogs
  • Product pricing tables for service providers
  • Restaurant menus with multiple sections
  • Course schedules for education websites
  • Employee directories with contact info
  • Event listings with dates and times
  • FAQs and knowledge base content
  • Data-rich dashboards and reports

sections.faq:
Can I use TableMaster with the free version of Elementor?

Yes! TableMaster is fully compatible with both Elementor Free and Pro versions.

Is TableMaster beginner-friendly?

Absolutely. If you can use Elementor, you can use TableMaster. No coding skills are required.

Can I import data from Google Sheets or a CSV file?

Yes, you can import CSV files, and Pro users can sync data directly from Google Sheets.

Is TableMaster optimized for speed?

Yes, TableMaster is built with performance in mind and won’t slow down your website.

Is the TableMaster Elementor table widget responsive on mobile devices?

Yes, TableMaster is built with responsiveness in mind. The Elementor table widget adapts perfectly to mobile and tablet screens.

Does TableMaster work with WooCommerce or custom post types?

Yes, you can dynamically pull in content from WooCommerce products, custom post types, categories, tags, and more.
